test_summary: Test Summary: The test scenario involved adding a new pet owner with the first name "J", last name "Smith", and other details including a telephone number formatted as "609-591-6230". After submission, the resulting page displayed a validation error specifically on the telephone field, indicating "Telephone must be a 10-digit number" with an error icon. This prevented the addition of "J Smith" as an owner, which aligns with the test oracle stating that "J Smith" should not be an owner. Therefore, the test passed successfully.
